_comment: Shared job/node picker. Include with $ref per key (file.json#/drona_job_scope); this key is never rendered.
$drona_job_scope  - the ONE selected job id. Job-level panels use it (retriever param JOBID, condition !drona_job_scope.).
$drona_node_scope - the ONE selected node, only set once a job is picked. Node-level panels use it (param NODE, condition !drona_node_scope.).
$drona_info_jobs - ALL job ids of the workflow, space separated (params JOBS/JOBIDS). Only for panels that span jobs on purpose (seff, jobs panel, WorkflowHistory).
Do not define other node/job pickers in panels; read these values instead.
